cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)


# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME Proj01)

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# Add sources to executable
file(GLOB_RECURSE USER_SOURCES
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/User/*.c"
)
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${USER_SOURCES}
)

# Add user application sources that are not managed by STM32CubeMX
# (so that renaming/adding them never breaks the CMake configure step)
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/freertos_demo.c
)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Inc
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/User/BSP/Inc
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/User/App/Inc
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/User/Algorithm/Inc
)

# Add manually ported FreeRTOS kernel
# NOTE: keep the kernel OUT of Middlewares/ - STM32CubeMX deletes that folder
#       whenever the project is re-generated.
set(FREERTOS_DIR      ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/ThirdParty/FreeRTOS/Source)
set(FREERTOS_PORT_DIR ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/GCC/ARM_CM3)

if(NOT EXISTS ${FREERTOS_DIR}/tasks.c)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "FreeRTOS kernel not found in ${FREERTOS_DIR}\n"
        "Expected: tasks.c/include/portable(GCC/ARM_CM3 + MemMang/heap_4.c)")
endif()

set(FREERTOS_SOURCES
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/croutine.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/event_groups.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/list.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/queue.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/stream_buffer.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/tasks.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/timers.c
    ${FREERTOS_PORT_DIR}/port.c
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c
)

# Create FreeRTOS static library
add_library(FreeRTOS OBJECT)
target_sources(FreeRTOS PRIVATE ${FREERTOS_SOURCES})

# FreeRTOS headers (FreeRTOSConfig.h is in Core/Inc, provided by stm32cubemx)
target_include_directories(FreeRTOS PUBLIC
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/include
    ${FREERTOS_PORT_DIR}
)

# Inherit MCU symbols (STM32F103xB, USE_HAL_DRIVER) and Core/Inc
target_link_libraries(FreeRTOS PUBLIC stm32cubemx)

# Also add the kernel include paths directly to the application target so that
# FreeRTOS.h / task.h are always resolvable (compile + IntelliSense), no matter
# how the libraries are linked, and without relying on the generated files.
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    ${FREERTOS_DIR}/include
    ${FREERTOS_PORT_DIR}
)

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
)

# Remove wrong libob.a library dependency when using cpp files
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

# Add linked libraries
# NOTE: keep the plain signature here, cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt
# (regenerated by STM32CubeMX) uses the plain signature for the same target.
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx
    FreeRTOS
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Guard against STM32CubeMX re-generation: cmake/stm32cubemx/CMakeLists.txt is
# rewritten by CubeMX and may reference files that the user deleted or renamed
# (e.g. Core/Src/freertos.c). Skip such entries instead of failing configure.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_target_property(_proj_sources ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} SOURCES)
set(_proj_sources_existing "")
foreach(_src IN LISTS _proj_sources)
    if(EXISTS "${_src}")
        list(APPEND _proj_sources_existing "${_src}")
    else()
        message(STATUS "Skip missing source file: ${_src}")
    endif()
endforeach()
set_target_properties(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES SOURCES "${_proj_sources_existing}")
